sources.anchor: Using the COS console; bucket name, region, and access permission
sources.applicability: Regional COS console bucket creation. Bucket name and region are immutable after creation.
The complete bucket identity is BucketName-APPID. The setup candidate never derives APPID from a credential.

sources.anchor: Bucket policy composition; all users; specified directory
sources.applicability: Anonymous GetObject may be scoped to one specified directory prefix. Account-level and existing-bucket bucket-wide expansion remain disabled.

sources.anchor: Function description; overwrite warning; Rule Filter Prefix
sources.applicability: Positive expiration days on one non-empty exclusive prefix. PUT Bucket lifecycle replaces the existing configuration, so unrelated rules must be retained.

sources.anchor: PUT Bucket cors; complete CORS configuration; CORSRule
sources.applicability: Bucket-level CORS on a newly created dedicated bucket only. The complete ruleset must retain unrelated rows and reject overlap.
A dedicated programmatic CAM sub-user under the confirmed account; no root-account credential is requested.

sources.anchor: Create a sub-account API key; SecretKey shown only at creation
sources.applicability: One SecretId/SecretKey pair for the planned CAM sub-user, handed off once and never put in a normal result.

sources.anchor: Working with COS API Authorization Policies; prefix-scoped resource example
sources.applicability: A CAM policy restricted to the planned complete BucketName-APPID and object-key prefix.

sources.anchor: AssumeRole; Credentials; Expiration; least-privilege best practice
sources.applicability: Caller-supplied process-only live verification input. Temporary credentials are neither issued nor persisted by setup.
Regional virtual-hosted Public Base URL and bucket identity. The S3-compatible service endpoint remains the separate data candidate.
